meta.title: Task brief
meta.description: Answers the first task of every new Session with a task brief before working: what the task really is, its type, difficulty, hard requirements, workload, token and time estimates, and the model plus reasoning effort it recommends for the job. Recommendations only — your model selection is never changed. Later tasks and resumed Sessions stay quiet.

hintTitle: The first task of a new Session is answered with a task brief: task, type, difficulty, requirements, workload, token and time estimates, and the recommended model with reasoning effort. Work starts right after it; models are recommended, never switched automatically.
